source: WAF logs for the WebACL attached to CloudFront EVTSA9VEHNZVH -- CloudWatch Logs group aws-waf-logs-opal-cloudfront, queried with Logs Insights. CloudFront STANDARD logging is DISABLED on this distribution (Logging.Enabled=false, empty bucket), there are 0 real-time log configs and no monitoring subscription, and CloudFront metrics are per-distribution, never per-path -- so this is the only instrument that records a request's URI. The logging configuration carries NO LoggingFilter, so every evaluated request is logged and an ALLOWed GET of the bare path does appear; retention is 400 days.

window_30d.why: the 7-day window cannot see a MONTHLY consumer; 30 days closes that and returns the same 2

method: the bare count is a SUBTRACTION from a printed denominator, not a forward list: every URI containing /json-tiered/ minus every URI containing /api/general/json-tiered/. The twin's 1752 (7d) / 7139 (30d) is the POSITIVE CONTROL -- it proves the instrument sees this traffic class, so the bare path's 2 is a real reading and not a silent query miss.
who_they_were: BOTH came from this device: the client IP equals site Z's own public egress IP, read at the act (checkip.amazonaws.com) and compared -- MATCH. Both carry scripted user agents (Python-urllib, curl), both landed today, after row NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-S114 was filed and around the CTO ruling, and both ask for the exact key the row and this order quote. They are the fabric's own proof-of-hole GETs, not a consumer. No browser, no portal referer, no third-party UA, and nothing on the bare path in the other 29 days.
portal_consumer: the portal reads /api/general/json-tiered/* only (portal/src/api/endpoints/market.ts, the CTO's ruling msg 34093); that path carries 7139 of the 7141 json-tiered requests in 30 days.
non_application: this read cannot speak for a consumer that has never called in 30 days, and it cannot see a request that bypassed CloudFront (a direct S3 read under the bucket's own policy is a different plane). Neither is in this cell's scope; the act narrows the CloudFront path only.
